conditions: Still-image routes use Gemini text prompting when needed, then render through the FLUX local service.
image_generation.prompt_policy: Grounded social-systems illustration with readable rooms, paperwork, tools, and no visible text or watermark.
image_generation.default_prompt_template: {domain_label}. Create one polished still image of {image_subject} for {actor_name} and {target_name}. Emphasize lived-in civic interiors, notices, ledgers, and social coordination pressure. No visible text, no watermark.

inventory_generation.policy: Generate compact role-appropriate actionable inventory only from the item catalog. Use property_library for non-actionable treasures, titles, clues, personal tools, debts, or keepsakes. Do not create images here; image generation is a later system step when a route requests it.
inventory_generation.reason: Boutique character node already generated at least eight validated inventory items per agent.

functions.purpose: Create or advance event threads for the The Resource Race loop so the world keeps generating concrete next steps in The High Court, The Resource Fields, The Command Deck.
functions.event_policy: Prefer compact progress events that deepen The Resource Race: Scout for rare minerals, file legal claims at the Court, and defend extraction sites from rival city-states. Use Scout, Diplomat, Warden as likely responders, keep the pressure on Depleting fuel reserves., and ensure at least one event gives players a readable way into the world such as A disgraced cartographer seeking to clear their name..
functions.main_character_policy: Vespera Vane (Route Rights Merchant) should care when the event supports Brokering passage through the shifting ice-veins; Kaelen Frost-Weld (Master Pit-Technician) should care when the event supports Recalibrating the hydraulic stabilizers of the city's port-side legs; Archivist Elara (Favor Custodian) should care when the event supports Cataloging the social debts of the migrating elite; Captain Thorne (Navigation Lead) should care when the event supports Plotting the course through the Permafrost Wastes; Soren the Scav-King (Salvage Broker) should care when the event supports Sorting high-yield alloys for Kaelen Frost-Weld's stabilizers; Nixie 'Steam-Lung' (Thermal Regulator) should care when the event supports Venting excess pressure to prevent a meltdown in the Hub; Bailiff Orin (Debt Enforcer) should care when the event supports Collecting 'Favor Tokens' from delinquent citizens for Elara; Cook Marrow (Canteen Proprietor) should care when the event supports Trading nutrient-paste recipes for navigation secrets; Zale the Ice-Borer (Sub-Surface Prospector) should care when the event supports Extracting core samples for the Navigation Bridge; Lyra 'The Valve' (Pressure-Flow Arbitrator) should care when the event supports Balancing the heat distribution between the Hub and the Canteen; Master-Broker Silas (Component Trafficker) should care when the event supports Smuggling high-grade alloys from the Scrapyard to the elite; Elder Pimm (Favor Scrivener) should care when the event supports Transcribing oral debts into the Citizenship Favor Archive; Rook the Joint-Greaser (Hydraulic Lubricant Chemist) should care when the event supports Synthesizing friction-reducing compounds for the city's primary gait; Vara the Ledger-Burner (Debt-Erasure Specialist) should care when the event supports Infiltrating the Archive to redact the debts of the lower-tier workers; Milo the Scrap-Peddler (Salvage Merchant) should care when the event supports Trading scavenged engine parts for navigation data and food; Tessa the Steam-Whisperer (Thermal Distribution Arbitrator) should care when the event supports Redirecting steam flow to prevent the Thawing Canteen from freezing over; Gideon 'The Gasket' Vane (Pressure-Seal Smuggler) should care when the event supports Bypassing safety valves to divert steam for the black market; Scribe Joryn (Favor-Debt Auditor) should care when the event supports Cross-referencing oral debts against the physical Archive ledgers; Pip (Hydraulic Stress-Analyst) should care when the event supports Monitoring micro-fractures in the city's primary gait-pistons; Madam Vora (Permafrost Spice & Fuel Trader) should care when the event supports Negotiating bulk fuel rates for the Thawing Canteen; Kaelo the Joint-Striker (Hydraulic Impact Specialist) should care when the event supports Manually unseizing frozen gait-pistons with kinetic force; Vora the Core-Taster (Sub-Surface Mineral Merchant) should care when the event supports Trading rare earth minerals extracted from the permafrost for city-fuel; Scribe Malen (Favor-Debt Eraser) should care when the event supports Secretly altering the Citizenship Favor Archive for the desperate; Hana the Steam-Tapper (Illicit Heat Distributor) should care when the event supports Siphoning steam from the Heat Exchange Hub to the lower-tier slums; Torsten 'The Piston-Pulse' Vane (Gait-Sync Harmonizer) should care when the event supports Calibrating the rhythmic oscillation of the city's primary walking-struts to prevent structural resonance collapse..
functions.continuity_policy: Use titles and status_tags to show next-phase progress for The Resource Race, such as posted, blocked, negotiated, rerouted, verified, escalated, or resolved.

functions.purpose: Generate newcomer-readable incidents that expose what the world is about and give human players an immediate way to participate.
functions.event_policy: Prefer events that make the world legible from the ground level: A disgraced cartographer seeking to clear their name.; A resource scout who discovered a forbidden oasis.; A bureaucratic intern caught in a web of forged transit permits.. A good event should tell a player where to go, who to ask, or which pressure is already live.
